verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform docs explicitly promise automatic tax calculation, filing, multi-state compliance, and tax configuration (gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-45, gusto-docs-37), which squarely covers this story. However, community evidence includes a specific, credible incident where Gusto mishandled W-2 tax filings, resulting in payroll being double-reported to the IRS with support unable to resolve it (gusto-comm-11), plus broader complaints about declining reliability of specialized tax support (gusto-comm-12, gusto-comm-13), directly contradicting the 'automatic and reliable' claim.
